title: Agent Factory: factory-owned authorization and login
outcome: The IdP handles identity only; every role, grant, multi-email principal mapping, domain rule, and check lives in factory storage behind the factory's one API, so access changes need no redeploy and no Cloudflare edit, and no route answers without a verified credential except the login page.
risks: Lockout: cutover or broken IdP leaves admins unreachable. Mitigated by API refusal to delete/downgrade the last active human admin (409), importing Dale's admin grant, a sealed non-expiring break-glass key in Secrets Manager, and an out-of-band cloud IAM recovery command that works any time (even if an unreachable admin grant exists) and preserves the ledger chain (S6).

Cross-IdP email spoofing if an IdP returns unverified emails. Mitigated by refusing any IdP assertion without email_verified=true and enforcing globally unique lowercased email-to-principal mappings (D2, S1).
Grant-store outage denies all access; fail-closed is intended (R8) but takes the factory down with the store.
Removing Access as defense in depth for API-key requests on /api/v1 (D9) makes key verification the only barrier; keys are verified before any handling (D23) and live-intersected with owner grants.
Owner-string migration could orphan live agents; dry-run must show none before cutover (S18).

Personal-agent transfer could leak outgoing owner's personal OAuth accounts or private skills; mitigated by automatically purging oauth-user tokens and detaching outgoing-owner private skills on accept (D15, S3b).
Health behind keys could break load-balancer probes unless a private listener or key is used (S16).
Shadow-mode mismatches block cutover until zero mismatches are verified in shadow mode (S8).

epics.title: Factory-owned authorization (IdP = identity only)
acceptance_criteria: R1-R18 and product flows 1-7 hold, each covered by unit and e2e tests (see companion).
Stories S1-S24, S2b, S3b, S5b meet their acceptance criteria (see companion).
No route answers without a verified credential except the login page and named, protected exceptions in the route-exception registry; conformance tests enforce it.
No reads of FACTORY_ADMIN_EMAILS or FACTORY_TOKENS remain; FACTORY_TOKEN and the shared Access service token are retired.
Onboarding a person (1..N verified emails across configured IdPs, or via a domain grant) needs only a factory grant, no Cloudflare edit or redeploy.
DESIGN_AUTHORITY.md (A1, A2 amendments, ownership section) and SPEC.md updated.
Deploy check proves an anonymous request gets the factory login page and every other route refuses it.

epics.title: Follow-on: Skill-driven egress policy
acceptance_criteria: Out of this plan's delivery (D17): recorded for linkage only; the story-breaker creates no stories for it until its own plan is merged.
Adopting a skill writes its declared requires.routes into the agent's AgentPolicy automatically, one direction only.
Policy is not a second manual edit surface; no agent route exists that no skill justifies.
Adoption brings the skill's default hold policy into the agent's hold settings (S23).
